releaseNotes:
Shane's ID Studio v1.0.6

What's New
• Improved AI Photo Set workflow and layouts
• Added Ready-to-Use Photo mode
• Added A4, Letter, Legal, Long 8.5×13, A5, and A3 paper sizes
• Improved Paper selector and Photo Set controls
• Added modern UI styling and Settings-based accent colors
• Added Under Development and Beta feature badges
• Improved Crop Photo interface
• Added Help & How To Use window
• Added Developer Information, donation, and contact sections
• Added update notifications and improved update experience

This release focuses on usability, workflow improvements, and a cleaner overall experience.

Thank you for using and supporting Shane's ID Studio.
